knownGaps: No single official source found with a complete end-to-end one-row-per-day-stage Nordkalottleden inventory from Kautokeino to all southern variants.

The first section has a geometry/distance split: official Luontoon/Reisa stage is Kilpisjärvi-Saarijärvi 11 km, OSM relation is about 12.8 km, and E1 GPX is about 18.4 km because it includes a broader access/E1 continuation alignment.
Saarijärvi endpoint must be normalized between old route/bridge cluster and the 2023 new hut yard before import.
Several facility records are pending coordinate/currentness verification, especially Tsahkaljärvi public facilities and Saarijärvi toilet/wood/waste coordinates.
